The '''Sloo sector''' was a [[sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Official Guide" /> It was home to the [[Temperature|cold]] [[mountain]] [[planet]] [[Vandor]]. The [[Lesser Sloo Gas Cloud]] [[nebula]] shared its name with the sector.<ref name="Tales" />
